title: RBI Eases Capital Adequacy Rules for Quarterly Profit Inclusion in CET1
summary: RBI removes 25% NPA provisioning condition, allowing commercial banks to reckon audited/limited-reviewed quarterly profits into CET1 capital.

blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 RBI Eases Capital Adequacy Rules for Quarterly Profit Inclusion in CET1. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: RBI amended capital adequacy directions, removing the qualifying condition linked to previous-year NPA provisions and simplifying the inclusion of quarterly profits into Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) capital.
